Milestone: Tokenization and Authorization with JWKS

Episódio Auth: Tokenization de usuário e senha, usando JWT com keypair RSA, Claims RS256, JWKS em /.well-known/jwks.json.

Outcomes: Tokenization de usuário e senha, revogação de usuário em Redis, uso de JWKS para revogação. Falhas relevantes: uso de HS256, uso de Redis.

Milestone: "Executor-based concurrent execution with high throughput and low latency"

Cluster: "WAL + busy_timeout, pool R2D2 16 readers, single-writer Mutex, falha DeadlockTimeout sob 100 writers, backoff jitter, métricas Prometheus"

Outcomes:
- High throughput: 1000 transactions per second
- Low latency: 100ms
- High availability: 99.9% uptime
- High reliability: 99.9% write success rate

Falhas relevantes:
- DeadlockTimeout: 100 writers
- Busy_Timeout: 100 writers
- Pool_Size: 16 readers
- Mutex_Size: 16 readers
- Backoff_Jitter: 10ms
- Prometheus_Metric: 100 writers
